sources.text:
Visit Cavan Burren Park's wide open landscapes, perfectly preserved glacial erratics and spectacular dolmens. The knowledgeable local guides will help you experience a vast world of natural and man made history.

Cavan Burren Park has a remarkable landscape where geology and archaeology features unfold in a natural setting. Discover peaceful birdsong, rich biodiversity, stunning views, an interpretative centre and five marked trails, one fully accessible for all to enjoy and waiting to be explored.

Explore a terrain shaped from a tropical sea south of the equator and through various ice ages. Take time in the interpretative centre where creative displays tell the Cavan Burren Park’s geological, archaeological, mythological and cultural story.

With picnic areas, parking for cars and coaches, toilets, guided tours available via prebooking and free admission, it’s an ideal spot to enjoy fresh air and spectacular scenery.
